categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of semiconductor silicon materials. Its main products include semiconductor silicon polished wafers, silicon materials for etching equipment, and semiconductor zone-melted silicon single crystals. These products are used in integrated circuits, discrete devices, power devices, sensors, optical devices, and etching equipment components, serving industries such as automotive electronics, industrial electronics, and aerospace.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced crystal growth technologies including Czochralski (CZ) method for single crystal silicon growth and zone melting for high-purity silicon. Core technologies include thermal field simulation and design, doping and defect control, large-diameter crystal growth, silicon wafer heat treatment, fine processing, cleaning and testing, and ultra-low oxygen control in single crystal growth. The company has proprietary intellectual property and applies digital management systems like MES and SAP for production control.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are downstream semiconductor chip manufacturers and etching equipment component manufacturers. The products serve the semiconductor industry, including integrated circuit fabrication, discrete and power devices, sensors, and emerging fields like automotive electronics, 5G, IoT, and aerospace. The company’s customers are mainly located in China, the US, Japan, South Korea, and Taiwan.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Beijing and production facilities in Shandong Province. It serves domestic and international markets, with significant sales in China and exports to other countries and regions including the US, Japan, South Korea, and Taiwan. The company is expanding capacity and technology to meet global semiconductor demand.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream segment of the semiconductor supply chain, focusing on the production of semiconductor-grade silicon materials used as foundational inputs for chip manufacturing and etching equipment components. It supplies critical raw materials to downstream semiconductor manufacturers and equipment producers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include accelerating capacity expansion projects for 8-inch silicon wafers and etching equipment silicon materials, driving innovation through R&D in crystal growth and wafer processing technologies, and enhancing product quality and cost control. The company emphasizes indigenous substitution of raw materials and equipment, talent development, and expanding into new semiconductor-related businesses. R&D focuses on advanced silicon materials, ultra-low oxygen crystals, and large-diameter wafers to meet evolving chip fabrication needs.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of semiconductor silicon wafers, etched silicon materials, and related products to chip manufacturers and equipment makers. The company uses a mainly direct sales model supplemented by limited agency and distribution channels. Pricing is market-driven with adjustments based on supply-demand dynamics and customer customization requirements.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic semiconductor silicon material supplier in China, recognized as a national technology center and innovation demonstration enterprise. It competes with global leaders such as Shin-Etsu, SUMCO, and GlobalWafers, focusing on catching up in advanced process technologies and expanding product offerings. The company holds a strong position in 6-8 inch wafers and etching silicon materials, with growing capabilities in 12-inch wafer production through investments and partnerships.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 960 million, a decrease of 18.29% year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 254 million, down 27.65%. Despite industry downturns, the company maintains steady production utilization and continues investing in capacity expansion and R&D. Total assets reached over RMB 5 billion with net assets around RMB 4.15 billion, reflecting moderate growth and ongoing strategic investments.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes technological leadership with proprietary core technologies in crystal growth and wafer processing, enabling high-quality, stable semiconductor silicon materials. It offers differentiated products such as ultra-low oxygen single crystals and large-diameter wafers tailored for advanced semiconductor applications. The company also focuses on cost competitiveness through raw material localization and supply chain security, providing reliable and innovative materials to meet evolving customer demands in a strategic domestic market.
